fusions.name: Gap in the Wall
fusions.desc: Drives a needle into the first enemy it meets, dealing 35 damage that ignores armour.

fusions.name: Sewn Fast
fusions.desc: A quick thrust that deals 4 damage and has a 15% chance to leave the target [Pinned] for 1.5 seconds.

fusions.name: Needlepoint Sheath
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 50% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it.

fusions.name: Pricked Alert
fusions.desc: Each time you land a critical hit, a bolt leaps to the nearest enemy within 7 tiles, dealing 5 damage. Once every 6 seconds.
